scenarios.assert: Wheat binds to ingredient:wheat but 200 source units cannot be committed as kilograms without conversion.
Glow Mushrooms bind to ingredient:glow-mushroom; no raw magical effect is inferred.
Hardwood Bundles remain a non-ingredient/cross-domain definition gap.
Focused Harvest may apply +25% only to an already source-listed/bound output and cannot establish identity.
Three crop stages use authored Project/Base Turn blocks and never wall-clock advancement.
DC+5 growth gives +25% final yield but does not automatically set D17 quality.
Harvest failure applies source -25% to an authored yield expression.
Animal Pen may bind ingredient:animal-milk without creating a universal quantity or species.
Aquaculture output requires a canonical ingredient whose acquisition/agriculture profile permits aquaculture/husbandry.
Apiary production can use canonical husbandry-eligible bee products but must author facility-specific quantity.
Monster husbandry requires authored renewable/nonlethal linkage; postmortem harvest/butchery remains ICF-07.
Agri-drones may satisfy an authorized step but cannot advance offline or spend resources by themselves.
Distribution Terminal +10% income is routed to MIB-13 and does not create an ICF price ledger.
Agriculture food-buff examples do not override ICF-12 finished-food rules.
Agriculture raw-crop spoilage is scoped separately from ICF-12 finished-food spoilage.
Elemental/magical crop mutation cannot write an ad hoc live property outside the Asset/rules owner.
Clipped PDF crop labels are not reconstructed; preexisting governed source assertions are reused.
Missing Agriculture appendix is a coverage gap, not permission to invent a crop index.
